arguments.message:
Hi! All of your invoices are kept in your workspace’s billing history for as long as the account is active—not just the current month. To view the full archive, go to **Settings → Billing → Invoices**. The page shows a table with every prior invoice (most recent at the top); the summary card at the top only displays the current month’s invoice. Each row links to a downloadable PDF.

Let me know if you need any more help!
